visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a man with short black hair and a plaid shirt blowing a red and white spiral party horn. His eyes are squinted with effort, and his cheeks are puffed out. The background is a vibrant purple and red blurred shelf with glass bottles. (2) Medium full shot of the man standing behind a wooden bar counter. He is smiling broadly and gesturing with both hands. In front of him are two roll cakes on white plates, each with a lit candle, and several colorful plush animal mascots. Colorful confetti is falling through the air. Above him is a neon sign that reads 'TAIWAN BAR' in blue and red. (3) Transition to a 2D animation phase featuring a black bear character with a white crescent on its chest, wearing a red hat, waving inside a bar setting. This is followed by a close-up of the animated bear shouting enthusiastically against a yellow sunburst background. (4) Screen capture of a website titled 'BIG CATCH' showing various courses, prices, and a group photo of male instructors. The interface is clean and professional with a white and green color scheme. (5) Return to the man at the bar counter. He continues to speak with high energy, using expansive hand gestures. The lighting is bright and warm, accentuating the festive atmosphere of the bar set. (6) Close-up shot of the man leaning in to blow out the candles on the cakes. After he blows, the candles emit a small spark and immediately reignite. The man looks at the camera with a surprised and slightly wide-eyed expression.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a sharp, medium-pitched blast from a party horn accompanied by pre-recorded sound effects of a crowd cheering and laughing loudly. An upbeat, high-tempo electronic BGM with a strong, driving four-on-the-floor beat fades in quickly. (2) A male voice enters with extremely high arousal and energy, shouting celebratory phrases with a wide pitch contour. The BGM remains consistent in the background, featuring bright synthesizer stabs. Sound effects of applause and whistling are layered to enhance the festive atmosphere. (3) As the speaker transitions into a narrative about the brand's history, the vocal delivery remains fast-paced but becomes slightly more focused. The BGM continues, providing a rhythmic backbone. A digital 'whoosh' sound effect marks the transition between spoken segments and graphical overlays. (4) The audio phase concludes with the sound of the speaker blowing air forcefully, followed by a comedic 'sparkle' or high-pitched 'ding' sound effect as the trick candles reignite. This is paired with surprised vocalizations and light background laughter from the crowd track.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Retrospective -> Promotion -> Call to Action -> Comedic Button
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a celebratory 11th-anniversary announcement for the brand 'Taiwan Bar'. It combines nostalgia by reflecting on past achievements (first animation in 2014) with current business promotion (Big Catch Academy). The final comedic segment with the trick candles acts as a retention hook to encourage engagement and comments.
